Friendly ping: could someone take a look at this when there's time? I'm happy to adjust anything. Thanks!

@pcbeingused333 I tried the zero-argument `now()` call through the gateway with the OpenAI Python SDK (`2.54.0`) in response to your [review request](https://github.com/theagentrouter/agent-router/pull/2900#issuecomment-7197997501). The local Vertex AI mock returned `{"functionCall":{"name":"now"}}`, omitting `args`. I decoded the SDK’s `function.arguments` with `json.loads` and passed the result to `now(**args)`. For streaming, I joined the argument fragments before decoding.

| Revision | Response | SDK argument string | Decoded in Python | Tool execution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base `56bd61f8` | Non-streamed | `"null"` | `None` | `TypeError` before entering `now()` (0 calls) |
| Base `56bd61f8` | Streamed | `"null"` | `None` | `TypeError` before entering `now()` (0 calls) |
| Head `2ce7ce30` | Non-streamed | `"{}"` | `{}` | `now()` ran once and returned `12:00:00Z` |
| Head `2ce7ce30` | Streamed | `"{}"` | `{}` | `now()` ran once and returned `12:00:00Z` |

All four requests returned HTTP 200 with finish reason `tool_calls`. The mock sent byte-for-byte identical replies on base and head for each mode. This confirms the fix lets a Python caller invoke the zero-argument tool in both modes.

On `2ce7ce30`, streamed and non-streamed first turns each invoked `now()` exactly once and produced identical second-request JSON at the Gemini mock, including a `functionResponse` named `now` with `response.output` equal to `12:00:00Z`.

I pushed a [signed-off, test-only commit](https://github.com/ericmariasis/ai-gateway/commit/0d5c0e9caf887190fc356d8488da033499c028d0) you can cherry-pick onto this PR. Both Go cases fail on the base at the empty-arguments check and pass on `2ce7ce30`, including the second request through the mock.

@ericmariasis Thanks for checking this through the gateway and for the test. I cherry-picked your commit onto the branch with your authorship and sign-off. Both cases pass here, also with current `main` merged in, and both fail when the two translator files are reverted to `56bd61f8`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
